memory_ids.description: The live memories that say one thing, two or more; each is superseded by the row written.

text.description: The merged row's text, in English, holding what each merged row said.

recallCondition.description: The situation in which it is needed; the one every merged row shares where none is given.

releaseCondition.description: The situation that ends it; the one every merged row shares where none is given.
